```python
# filename: compute_pct_increase.py
import pandas as pd

# Reconstruct the same dataset
data = [
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity® Emerging Markets Index Fund", "Ticker": "FPADX", "NAV May 2019": 10.50, "NAV May 2024": 12.08, "Transaction Fee": "$0", "Category": "Emerging Markets Equity"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity® Emerging Markets Fund", "Ticker": "FEMKX", "NAV May 2019": 31.20, "NAV May 2024": 37.98, "Transaction Fee": "$0", "Category": "Emerging Markets Equity"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity® Advisor Emerging Asia Fund Class A", "Ticker": "FSEAX", "NAV May 2019": 22.15, "NAV May 2024": 26.80, "Transaction Fee": "$0", "Category": "Emerging Markets Equity"},
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df["Pct_Increase"] = ((df["NAV May 2024"] - df["NAV May 2019"]) / df["NAV May 2019"]) * 100

print("Computed percentage increases:\n", df[["Fund Name","Ticker","Pct_Increase","Transaction Fee","Category"]].to_string(index=False))

sorted_df = df.sort_values(by="Pct_Increase", ascending=True)
print("\nSorted ascending by percentage increase:\n", sorted_df[["Fund Name","Ticker","Pct_Increase"]].to_string(index=False))

min_row = sorted_df.iloc[0]
print(f"\nLowest percentage increase: {min_row['Fund Name']} ({min_row['Ticker']}) -> {min_row['Pct_Increase']:.2f}%")
```
